title: Copy text to the system clipboard using xclip
summary: Use xclip to send text from a command or file directly to the system clipboard, so you can paste it with Ctrl+V in other applications.

steps.explain: Pipe the output of a command (like echo) into xclip to copy it to the clipboard.

placeholders.name: TEXT
placeholders.description: The text you want to copy

alternatives.explain: Copy the contents of a specific file to the clipboard.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to copy
